text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Nachhaltige Treib- und Brennstoffe werden wichtige Beiträge zum Erreichen der Ziele der Energiestrategie und langfristigen Klimastrategie leisten.", "gist": "Sustainable fuels will make important contributions to achieving energy and long-term climate strategy goals."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Ausschreibung «Sustainable Fuels and Platform Chemicals»", "gist": "Call for proposals titled 'Sustainable Fuels and Platform Chemicals'"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Bundesamt für Zivilluftfahrt (BAZL)", "gist": "Federal Office of Civil Aviation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "armasuisse", "gist": "Swiss defence procurement agency"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Die Forschenden sollen untersuchen, wie die Schweiz ihren zukünftigen Bedarf an nachhaltigen Treib- und Brennstoffen und Plattformchemikalien decken kann.", "gist": "Researchers are to investigate how Switzerland can meet its future demand for sustainable fuels and platform chemicals."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Technologien zur Produktion, Transport, Verteilung, Speicherung und Nutzung sollen weiterentwickelt werden.", "gist": "Technologies for production, transport, distribution, storage, and use are to be further developed."}]}
